title: LocomotionCapability
description: Structured data-driven locomotion capability specification for LinhSinhVN (organism-owned capability profile; does NOT define world topology)

is_available.description: Whether this locomotion capability is currently active/unlocked on the organism

supported_layers.description: Capability compatibility list: Z-strata where this capability is anatomically functional (authoritative topology remains owned by SpatialWorld)

supported_transitions.description: Capability compatibility list: Transition types this capability can attempt (authoritative topology requirements remain owned by SpatialWorld)

speed_modifier.description: Integer speed scaling factor in basis points (100 = 1.0x baseline)
